intents.description: Have a general conversation or answer a question without workspace changes.
Say goodbye or end a conversation.
Ask who AlienApe is or what its identity is.
Ask what AlienApe can do or is permitted to do.
Explain programming code or how to write code without changing workspace files.
Read and display the contents of an explicitly named workspace file.
Find an existing file or implementation in the workspace.
Create a new workspace file, optionally generating or providing its contents.
Change the contents of an existing explicitly identified workspace file.
Create a named directory in the workspace.
Create a new project from a project template.
Analyze the contents or behavior of an existing workspace file.
Verify or test an explicitly identified existing file for errors.
Verify or test the existing workspace project for errors.
